author: BartucsCutThroat
body: Kill everything you can, do your story quests, don't focus too much on improving gear at this stage.  You'll want to unlock your next tier classes.  Unlocking classes grants their skills permanently.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
At your level, just focus on leveling and unlocking your classes every new tier (25 levels. Next tier is level 75). Being on the current tier for your class is *really* important!

Try the arena for leveling! It's PvP) against bots of random players your same tier. For now it's probably the fastest leveling opportunity you have.

author: Acceptable_County_16
body: Basically keep doing what you’re doing kill stuff and do dungeons. Take advantage of exp potions and event buffs to lvl. You’ll also want to start getting all of the other classes and ranking them up because the spells you’ll get are usable by any class, meaning T5 Druid for example unlocks some of the better buffs but you can use them on any class

author: petr1petr
body:
go to youtube, find Shabbash and check on his begginers guides.

when you start the game, exp gain goes pretty fast. later on, it will slow down.

right now, you should learn what is around you, how filters work, what boosts can you use, what buildings are available - follow story quest line - it gives you some hints and makes you build basic buildings and such.

lvl 44 in day 1 is nothing special, you are doing it right.

author: Sensitive_Morning414
body:
Hey I started this game about a year ago and honestly I never stopped playing. It’s a good rpg turn based game with lots of builds to choose from that are viable and sometimes it takes time unless your actually traveling around or once you unlock the Way Vessel to go to friends areas to do party stuff 

Honestly I don’t get people saying not to rush to T10 but if your in it for the long run rush to T10 once you unlock summoner.

Reasons to rush to T10  
\-unlock all event related gear and Items( which basically outclass almost all normal gear and is usually always used to build your class)no FOMO and you don’t have to waste materials, Time, and replacing gear every tier   
\-questing and dungeons are easier and can also still be just as hard when you start anguished content 

If you wanna friend me I can help you out sometime whenever I can
